summary: Iteration 53: Tag System and File Navigation Features Testing. Backend: 20/20 tests passed. Frontend: All new features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test files with tags: bdddade5-95ea-432d-b75b-bbb7929b494d (tags: test, video, demo), dd417d50-1b8f-443f-b97e-6db910a664a0 (tags: video, sample)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tag system fully implemented and tested. Key findings: 1) GET /api/personal-files/tags returns unique tags with counts. 2) PUT /api/personal-files/files/{id}/tags updates tags (normalizes to lowercase, removes duplicates). 3) GET /api/personal-files/files?tag=xxx filters by tag. 4) GET /api/personal-files/files?search=xxx searches both filename and tags. 5) GET /api/personal-files/files/{id}/similar returns files with shared tags. 6) Frontend tag cloud visible below type filters with counts. 7) Clicking tag in cloud filters files, active tag highlighted in teal. 8) 'Сбросить' button clears active tag filter. 9) File cards show tag chips (max 2 + overflow count), clickable for filtering. 10) Video player shows tags at bottom with editable input. 11) 'Похожие по тегам' section shows similar files. 12) Navigation arrows (< >) work in video player. 13) Image/GIF preview modal has navigation arrows.
